6d35e307: What is the nickname of the mastermind behind the heists?
The Professor (Sergio Marquina) is the master strategist: his plans include a plan B, C and D for every surprise. His ability to anticipate the authorities' reactions is at the heart of the series.
ab635408: What iconic outfit do the robbers wear?
The Salvador Dalí masks and red jumpsuits have become worldwide symbols: the red stands for resistance and the masks keep the robbers anonymous.
3faea8b2: Which institution is targeted in the first heist (parts 1-2)?
The gang locks itself inside the Royal Mint of Spain to print its own banknotes: according to the Professor, they are not stealing anyone's money.
6da70e44: What is the name of the series' signature song?
“Bella Ciao” is an Italian anti-fascist folk song from the 1940s. Adopted as a resistance anthem, it became a worldwide symbol thanks to the series.
645873ee: Which inspector falls in love with the Professor?
Raquel Murillo (alias Lisbon) is the negotiating inspector. Her romance with the Professor develops alongside the heist, and she ends up joining the gang.
b30db90a: Why are the members named after cities?
The Professor's rule to avoid emotional ties
The Professor imposes city names to avoid emotional attachments that could compromise the heist. Romances and friendships form anyway, causing complications.
a6aa2519: What is the second big heist (parts 3-5)?
The Bank of Spain heist is the second job, far harder because the gang is already hunted and known to Spanish and international authorities.
0fcae382: Which character sacrifices himself at the end of the first heist?
Berlin sacrifices himself holding off the special forces so the others can escape, dying a hero under a hail of bullets. His ambivalent personality earned him a spin-off.
45f7f38c: How many parts does Money Heist have?
Money Heist has 5 parts: parts 1-2 for the first heist, parts 3-4-5 for the Bank of Spain. Part 5 is split into two volumes for the finale.
313ed4e2: What is the series' country of origin?
Money Heist is Spanish, created by Álex Pina. On its worldwide release it became Netflix's most-watched non-English-language series.
152016ce: Which gang member is the computer expert and hacker?
Rio (Aníbal Cortés) is the group's hacker and its youngest member. His relationship with Tokyo and his capture lead directly to the second heist at the Bank of Spain.
4273bfdf: What is the Professor's plan for the Royal Mint heist?
Hold hostages and print 2.4 billion euros
The plan is to hold the building with hostages for several days in order to print about 2.4 billion euros.
1e4b2968: Which actress plays Tokyo, the series' narrator?
Úrsula Corberó plays Silene Oliveira, alias Tokyo, the series' narrator with her recognizable voice-over. Her impulsive character contrasts with the Professor's rigor.
d29815fa: Who is Nairobi in the series?
Nairobi is the banknote printing expert who runs the printing room, beloved by viewers for her leadership and strength of character. Her death in part 4 shocks fans.
53765d2a: What is the real name of the character Palermo in the series?
Palermo (Martín Berrote) is introduced in part 3: Berlin's former partner and friend, who worked on the plan with him. He takes command inside during the Bank of Spain heist.
1e2d8fb7: What is the real first name of Tokyo, the narrator?
Tokyo's real name is Silene Oliveira, which is revealed gradually. Her voice-over gives each season an emotional thread.
e12760bf: Who is Helsinki in the gang?
A former Serbian soldier, a gentle giant
Helsinki is a former Serbian soldier and Oslo's cousin. This giant is the gang's muscle, but he is very protective of his comrades.
57935425: What is the Professor's real name in the series?
The Professor's name is Sergio Marquina. His father, a bank robber, died during a robbery, and Sergio spent years preparing the Royal Mint plan.
136a8a2e: What is the name of the character played by Álvaro Morte?
Álvaro Morte plays the Professor (Sergio Marquina), the mastermind of both heists. His calm, calculating and romantic character is central to the whole series.
00ec7741: In which city does most of Money Heist take place?
Madrid is the main setting: both the Royal Mint and the Bank of Spain are there, and iconic Madrid streets appear throughout the series.
9c071c16: Which actor plays Berlin in the series?
Pedro Alonso plays Andrés de Fonollosa, alias Berlin, the most ambiguous and fascinating character, who has his own spin-off. His domineering, cruel personality hides a deep sensitivity.
2dd83006: What is the Money Heist spin-off released on Netflix?
Berlin is the spin-off released in 2023. It follows Berlin (Pedro Alonso) before the events of Money Heist, with heists and relationships of his own.
8d377ce6: What is the relationship between Denver and Moscow?
Moscow is Denver's father, and their father-son bond is one of the most moving in the series. Agustín Ramos (Moscow) dies during the first heist, leaving Denver alone.
39c2731e: Which hostage does Denver fall in love with during the first heist?
Denver falls in love with Mónica Gaztambide, a pregnant Mint employee. Their relationship complicates the mission but becomes central to Denver's emotional arc.
cc94f9ea: How many active members does the gang have during the first heist (not counting the Professor)?
8 members are inside during the first heist: Tokyo, Berlin, Nairobi, Denver, Moscow, Rio, Helsinki and Oslo. The Professor coordinates from outside.
1b5462b0: How does Alicia Sierra, the inspector of parts 3-4, end up in the series?
She joins the Professor after being betrayed by the State
Alicia Sierra (Najwa Nimri) is abandoned by the State despite her pregnancy. She then sides with the Professor out of mutual interest, one of the series' most surprising twists.
210e0511: In which language is “Bella Ciao” sung, and what is its historical origin?
Spanish, a Spanish civil resistance song
Italian, an anti-fascist partisan song from World War II
“Bella Ciao” is an Italian anti-fascist song sung by partisans during the Italian Resistance (1943-1945). Its use in Money Heist made it a worldwide symbol of resistance.
cc584d75: What is the nationality of the character Helsinki in the series?
Despite their Nordic city names, Helsinki and Oslo are two Serbian cousins and former soldiers.
d87253c1: What is the real name of the character Denver in the series?
Denver (Daniel Ramos) is Moscow's son and one of the gang's most popular members: his trademark laugh (now a meme) and his relationship with Mónica Gaztambide are highlights of the series.
25c15410: How does Nairobi die in the series?
She is shot by Gandía, the bank's head of security
During the Bank of Spain heist, Gandía, the head of security, manages to seize Nairobi and shoots her. Her death in part 4 devastates the gang.
caa2d19d: What link between Berlin and the Professor is revealed in the series?
Berlin, Andrés de Fonollosa, is the Professor's older brother. This bond explains the trust Sergio places in him despite his unpredictable behavior.
6dcf6158: What illness does Berlin suffer from?
Berlin suffers from an incurable degenerative disease, Helmer's myopathy. Knowing he is doomed, he faces death with strange detachment.
f375f79d: How does Denver react when ordered to kill Mónica Gaztambide?
He hides her and fakes her death
He locks her in a closet

Denver cannot bring himself to kill Mónica: he hides her in a corner of the Mint and fakes her death. That decision turns a hostage situation into a love story and changes the course of the operation.
a64033d8: What is Mónica Gaztambide's job before she is taken hostage?
Deputy director of the Royal Mint
Mónica Gaztambide is the secretary of Arturo Román, the director of the Royal Mint, whose child she is expecting.
326e5d38: Who is Arturo Román and what is his role among the hostages?
The Mint's director, who repeatedly tries to sabotage the heist

Arturo Román is the director of the Royal Mint and Mónica's lover. He tries to sabotage the heist several times with misplaced heroics that put lives at risk, making him one of the most disliked characters among fans.
f1004000: Which police officer replaces Raquel Murillo as negotiator during the Bank of Spain heist?
Alicia Sierra is the pregnant inspector who becomes the main human antagonist in parts 3-4. Brutal and ruthless, she hunts the Professor with terrifying efficiency.
64035152: Which gang member, a former miner, digs the tunnel at the Royal Mint?
Moscow, a former miner and Denver's father, digs the escape tunnel during the first heist. He is fatally shot during the getaway.
643118dc: Which country produced a local adaptation of Money Heist?
South Korea produced Money Heist: Korea – Joint Economic Area (2022) for Netflix, set against a fictional reunification of the two Koreas.
a7e0e74e: How many volumes make up part 5 (the finale) of Money Heist?
Part 5 is split into 2 volumes: volume 1 (5 episodes, September 2021) and volume 2 (5 episodes, December 2021).
6992de3e: What is the name of Mónica's son, raised by Denver?
Mónica, now Stockholm, has a son, Cincinnati, whose biological father is Arturo Román. Denver raises him as his own.
f1b1ae64: How does Raquel Murillo (Lisbon) finally join the gang?
She was undercover from the start
She switches sides after discovering the truth about the Professor and his motives
Lisbon gradually understands the Professor's motives and falls in love with him. She deliberately chooses to join him, giving up her police career to become an active member of the gang.
7352f346: What is the name of Lisbon's subordinate who is in love with her throughout part 1?
Ángel Rubio is Raquel's subordinate inspector. In love with her for years, he is also the one who starts to suspect the Professor, her mysterious new boyfriend, putting the whole operation at risk.
cb1af7ae: Who is the original creator of Money Heist?
Álex Pina is the creator, showrunner and head writer of Money Heist. He developed it for the Spanish channel Antena 3 before Netflix acquired it and released it worldwide to colossal success.
d6c7f460: On which Spanish channel did Money Heist first air, in 2017?
The series first aired on Antena 3 in 2017, before Netflix acquired it and released it worldwide.
6dd97045: Under which English title is La Casa de Papel known?
Internationally, the series is called Money Heist.
46e9d3d5: Which award did Money Heist win in 2018?
The Golden Globe for best series
The International Emmy for best drama series
In 2018, the series won the International Emmy Award for best drama series.
4e681586: Under which false name does the Professor win over Raquel Murillo?
The Professor introduces himself to Raquel as Salva, a shy man she meets in a bar.
d7dc3c61: What codename does Raquel Murillo take when she joins the gang?
Raquel Murillo becomes Lisbon. Mónica Gaztambide, for her part, takes the name Stockholm.
f95bc653: What codename does Mónica Gaztambide take?
Mónica chooses Stockholm, a nod to Stockholm syndrome, since she fell in love with Denver during the hostage crisis.
e7471632: Miguel Herrán plays Rio, the gang's hacker. Jaime Lorente plays Denver.
471bf1d8: Alba Flores plays Nairobi. Itziar Ituño plays Raquel, Esther Acebo Mónica and Najwa Nimri Alicia Sierra.
bb677446: Which gang member, Helsinki's cousin, dies during the first heist?
Oslo is badly wounded by a hostage during the first heist and does not survive.
66d3d11e: What does the gang mainly steal at the Bank of Spain?
At the Bank of Spain, the gang seizes the gold reserve and melts it down so it can be carried out.
4ee412da: Which of these characters joins the gang for the Bank of Spain heist?
Bogotá, Marseille and Palermo are among the new recruits for the second heist.
a0c868fd: Berlin's name is Andrés de Fonollosa. Martín Berrote is Palermo, Agustín Ramos is Moscow and Sergio Marquina is the Professor.
3df71ab8: What is special about Inspector Alicia Sierra during the Bank of Spain heist?
Alicia Sierra leads the negotiations while pregnant, which does not stop her from being formidable.
3ae2232d: Which colonel leads the security forces during the Bank of Spain heist?
Colonel Luis Tamayo coordinates the State's response. Gandía is the bank's head of security.
96832299: Which gang member dies at the end of volume 1 of part 5?
Tokyo, the series' narrator, sacrifices herself against the soldiers at the end of volume 1 of the final part.
